stories.name: pensions
stories.approved_text: Auditors found two point two million pensioners underpaid and five hundred seventy thousand overpaid after reviewing four point seven million files. So yes, the calculator has entered witness protection.

stories.name: energy_prices
stories.approved_text: Over the past year, wholesale electricity climbed from about four hundred thirty-five to six hundred ninety lei per megawatt-hour, while gas more than doubled. Even the price cap now needs a price cap.

stories.name: government
stories.approved_text: President Nicușor Dan is preparing one nominee before S and P's October second review. After two failed investiture votes and sixty days, he may dissolve Parliament, triggering early elections. Cue the eject lever.
